notes.title: Patch update ver1.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed a problem in the 2nd stage the hammer don't cause enough distance depending on the player's size and playing style!
Fixed Chinese translation. 阿凡達 -> 人選擇 辭職 -> 退出
Fixed an error in the staff credits.

notes.title: The demo version and full trailer are now available!
notes.notes:
In time for Steam Next Fest October 2024 Edition, a demo version of this game is now available!
"Stage 1" can be played in its entirety with the same specifications as the full version.

Full Version Trailer.
The trailer of the full version is now available!
In this trailer you can see the later stages and it is the first time you can see them.

https://youtu.be/_SoyiGytpTA

Call for Streamer Collaborations!
We are actively seeking streamers to help showcase gameplay using the above features. Those who participate will receive a free Steam key for the full version and be credited in the game's Special Thanks section. We look forward to your applications!

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdO7w6_t-eMoim8mA_wa-viM51pJCJl9AvRyZybkYEdftluNQ/viewform
